purpose: Show ordered workflow progress and optionally revisit the current or completed steps through controlled navigation.
behaviorProvider: Native nav/list/buttons with local roving tab-stop and orientation-specific keyboard focus.

requirements.statement: Use an explicit item state when supplied; otherwise derive complete/current/upcoming from the zero-based currentStep. Mark the indexed current item with aria-current=step.
Without onStepChange, render informational step content rather than interactive controls. With a callback, render native buttons.
Enable only the current index or steps whose effective state is complete, unless the whole component is disabled. Request a change only for a different enabled step.
Maintain one tab stop among eligible steps. Orientation-appropriate arrows wrap focus, while Home and End focus the first or last eligible step without selecting it.
Expose step number, title and effective state in button labels and hidden state text; visual status markers are decorative.
Supply a valid currentStep, stable unique ids and an onStepChange handler that updates state. The component does not validate bounds or persist progress.
Perform validation, data saves and permission checks before applying requested changes; explicit completed states make earlier or later steps eligible.
Choose orientation and meaningful navigation naming for the surrounding page. Horizontal arrow mapping is physical left/right and is not automatically reversed for RTL.
Own pattern or component styling consumes navigation group tokens. Nested shared components retain their own group ownership; do not restyle their internals.

limitations: No step validation, next/back action, asynchronous lifecycle or automatic progress persistence.
Explicit states may disagree with the indexed current marker; hosts must keep them coherent.
No RTL-specific reversal of horizontal keyboard arrows.
